name: Cost per sellable unit finder
why: Turns a factory quote, freight, duty and fees into a real unit cost, the first input to the funding goal and every reward tier.

name: Landed cost calculator
why: A second check on landed cost per unit before the goal is set, useful when rewards ship from a factory abroad.

name: Product bill of materials builder
why: Breaks one factory quote into parts and price breaks, so the budget shows what changes if the campaign overfunds.

name: Supplier quote comparer
why: Compares factory quotes on price, minimum order and lead time, which sets the goal floor and the honest delivery date.

name: Factory price-break negotiator
why: Plans the factory talk after funding, when the backer count is known and the order can be placed.

name: Shipping rate planner
why: Builds shipping zones and rates by country, the part of reward pricing that most often loses money.

name: Product margin checker
why: Checks margin and the most you can spend on ads per backer, before any paid launch push is planned.

name: Bundle tier layout planner
why: Lays out tiers so they are easy to compare, the same job as a clear reward table on a campaign page.

name: Launch email sequence planner
why: A dated launch email plan with resends and a final close, which maps onto launch day and the final 48 hours.

name: Launch teaser to preview planner
why: Plans the teaser, preview and sign-up page that feed the pre-launch list before the campaign opens.

name: Idea validation analyst
why: Tests whether people want the product before the client spends on a prototype shoot and page.

name: Say-do gap checker
why: Checks survey answers against real behaviour, so a goal is not set on people who said yes but will not pledge.
